tools.name: get_inside_overview
tools.description: Return a short description of what Inside is and who it is for. Use this to answer "what is inside.ad / insideads" questions without navigating.

tools.name: open_advertiser_page
tools.description: Open the Inside page for advertisers who want to buy ads and run campaigns across Telegram channels.

tools.name: open_inside_app
tools.description: Open the Inside web app so the user can sign up or log in and start growing (publisher) or advertising on (advertiser) Telegram channels. Navigates the current browser tab to the app.

email.description: Optional email to pre-fill on the sign-up screen.
